scenario: A TIME-WEIGHTED SERIES replayed ([LFST.9.1], [LSIG.1.1]). `integral sliding 10_min` over one flow's readings 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 0.5 at 0, 3_s, 7_s and 9_s; `volume` emits the integral it reads each time. Each value weights the previous reading by the time it was held, so it is a function of the gaps between samples, which come only from the clock. Paths: libds records through `rfcs/codec.c`'s recorder and replays through `ds_rfcs_replay_*` (pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay`), which byte-compares each re-derived RuleFireAnnotation and FactEmit; the Mercury runtime records through `ds.rfcs` and replays through `ds.replay`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Flow scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    lpm: Float mutable

schema Volume scope ttl 1_h:
    label: String
    total: Float

series Flow.lpm (by: entity_id):
    integral sliding 10_min

rule volume:
    Flow f
->
    emit Volume label: f.entity_id total: f.integral
